name: KD-36 Bioweapon Dispersal Drone
description: The KD-36 Bioweapon Dispersal Drone was a model of probe droid that was used by the freelance spy known as the Shroud. It was designed to deploy poisonous gases and bioweapons, and KD-36 drones were deployed to eliminate individuals who were intruding on the Shroud's business.
